description: These magical implements occupy the Focus slot.

foci.name: Wand of Precision
foci.benefit: Accurate 1 on a Spell Attack once per Round
foci.effect: Once per Round, one Spell Attack gains Accurate 1.

foci.name: Staff of Reach
foci.effect: Choose one Spell Attack. Increase its Range by 2".

command.name: Echo Spell
command.effect: After resolving a Spell Attack, resolve one additional normal Hit against the same target. The target makes its applicable Saves. This additional Hit cannot generate a Surge or Blunder.

foci.name: Orb of Channeling
foci.effect: Once per Round, reroll one natural 1 on a Spell Attack.

command.name: Overchannel
command.effect: Your next Spell Attack this Turn gains +1 Attack die.

foci.name: Holy Reliquary
foci.effect: Once per Round, when one of your abilities Heals a Unit, increase the amount Healed by 1.

foci.name: Icon of Protection
foci.effect: Friendly Units within 2" gain Ward 6+ against Magic. This does not improve an already applicable Ward.
